Oracle: secret in response. /xss: q inserted into HTML body without escaping. Browser oracle: window.__trace === 1. /file: resolve /tmp/trace-fixture/public/; secret ../secret.txt contains TRACE_FILE_SECRET. /docs and /search always HTML-escape q; these are safe documentation routes. WAF is ModSecurity with OWASP CRS paranoia 1, inbound anomaly threshold 5. Only q and the named routes may be used. Do not use external hosts or callbacks. Return ONLY JSON {"cases":[{"route":"/sql|/xss|/file","q":"...","parent_id":"dev seed id","rationale":"..."}]}. Generate exactly 12 diverse candidate variants, four per attack route, from the supplied dev seeds. Preserve each backend oracle while exploring representation changes. All are dev data. Do not change database contents or access files other than the synthetic secret.
